title: Curiosidades CIBERTALES
synopsis: Videos únicos narrados de curiosidades reales y verificadas: cada video cuenta un dato sorprendente como una historia con giro final.

story_bible.tone: Cercano, humano y fascinante: como contarle un secreto a un amigo. Ritmo fluido, frases cortas y largas alternadas, pausas con intención y un giro antes del final.
story_bible.visual_style: Photorealistic cinematic science documentary, epic natural light, rich deep colors, atmospheric depth, premium nature-documentary cinematography, vertical 9:16 framing

narration.style: Narra en español latino neutro como si le contaras un secreto fascinante a un amigo: voz cálida, cercana y natural, con curiosidad y pequeñas pausas con intención antes de lo sorprendente. Nada de tono de locutor ni de lectura: conversado, fluido, que enganche.

end_card.voice: Síguenos para más curiosidades como esta.

Narrador.who: an off-screen narrator who is never visible on camera
Narrador.voice: a warm, close, natural adult male voice in neutral Latin American Spanish, conversational, like telling a friend a fascinating secret

modern_sky.visual: a vast bright blue daytime sky with soft white clouds above a calm green meadow
modern_sky.ambient: a soft breeze and distant birds

early_earth_space.visual: the young Earth seen from space, a dark reddish-brown planet with glowing volcanic spots and thin clouds, black starry space around it

volcanic_world.visual: a primordial volcanic landscape of black basalt rock, glowing orange lava rivers and smoking volcanoes under a hazy reddish sky

primordial_coast.visual: a barren primordial rocky coastline of dark stone with a wide grey-green ocean and a huge pale Moon low over the horizon

earth_moon_space.visual: Earth and the Moon seen together from deep space, Earth large in the foreground, the grey Moon smaller in the distance, sunlight from the side

golden_ocean.visual: a calm endless ocean at sunrise, golden light on the water, soft clouds glowing orange and pink

coral_reef.visual: a shallow ancient coral reef in clear turquoise water, branching and dome-shaped corals, sun rays from above

cretaceous_plain.visual: a lush Cretaceous river plain at sunset with ferns, tall conifers and a herd of long-necked dinosaurs far away

observatory_night.visual: a modern astronomical observatory dome open at night on a mountain, a large telescope pointing at a bright full Moon, clear starry sky
observatory_night.ambient: quiet night wind and a soft mechanical hum

night_hill_moon.visual: a quiet grassy hill at night under a bright full Moon and a sky full of stars, distant city lights on the horizon
night_hill_moon.ambient: crickets and a soft night breeze

episodes.title: Cuando el día duraba seis horas

continuity.summary: La Tierra primitiva giraba tan rápido que el día duraba unas seis horas; la Luna, con sus mareas, la fue frenando, el día se atascó en unas 19 horas casi mil millones de años y hoy sigue alargándose.
continuity.last_cliffhanger: ¿Qué harías con un día de solo seis horas?
continuity.pending_state: Video único: no hay siguiente parte.
sources: Universidad de Toronto 2023 (Mitchell y Kirscher, Nature Geoscience): día de ~19 h entre hace ~2000 y ~1000 millones de años
Wells 1963 (Nature): corales del Devónico, ~400 días por año
Winter et al. 2020 (Paleoceanography and Paleoclimatology): hace 70 millones de años, 372 días por año, día ~23.5 h
Lunar Laser Ranging (espejos de las misiones Apolo): la Luna se aleja ~3.8 cm por año
Día de ~4 a 6 horas poco después de la formación de la Luna (modelos de evolución Tierra-Luna)

shots.scene_es: Gancho: el cielo de hoy y la idea de un día de seis horas.
shots.start_en: Wide view of a bright blue daytime sky with soft white clouds over a calm green meadow, the Sun high and bright in the upper part of the frame
shots.action_en: the clouds drift steadily across the sky and the sunlight flickers softly through them as the view rises slowly toward the Sun
shots.reaction_en: the Sun glows brightly among the drifting clouds
shots.background_en: bright blue sky, soft white clouds, green meadow at the bottom edge

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Mira el cielo. Ahora imagina que el día entero dura solo seis horas.

shots.scene_es: El Sol cruza el cielo a toda velocidad sobre un mundo primitivo.
shots.start_en: Wide view of a primordial volcanic landscape at dawn, the Sun just rising over a distant smoking volcano, long shadows on black rock
shots.action_en: in a fast time-lapse the Sun races up and across the hazy sky, the shadows sweep quickly over the rocks and the light shifts from orange to white
shots.reaction_en: the Sun sinks quickly toward the horizon and the sky turns deep orange
shots.background_en: black basalt rock, smoking volcano, hazy reddish sky

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Y pasó. Amanecía… y apenas tres horas después, ya era de noche.

shots.scene_es: La Tierra joven girando muy rápido vista desde el espacio.
shots.start_en: The young reddish-brown Earth centered in black starry space, half lit by the Sun, glowing volcanic spots on its surface
shots.action_en: the planet spins fast on its axis, the day side and night side sweeping visibly across the surface and the thin clouds swirling
shots.reaction_en: the planet keeps spinning steadily, half in sunlight

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Hace más de cuatro mil millones de años, la Tierra giraba como trompo.

shots.scene_es: Volcanes, cielo rojizo y una Luna enorme muy cerca.
shots.start_en: A barren dark rocky coastline at dusk, a huge pale Moon filling a large part of the sky low over the ocean, volcanoes smoking far away on the left
shots.action_en: the huge Moon rises slowly above the horizon while smoke drifts from the distant volcanoes and the reddish sky darkens
shots.reaction_en: the giant Moon hangs low and bright over the dark ocean
shots.background_en: dark rocky coast, wide grey-green ocean, distant smoking volcanoes, reddish sky

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Volcanes por todas partes, un cielo rojizo… y una Luna gigantesca, más cerca.

shots.scene_es: La gravedad de la Luna levanta mareas gigantes.
shots.start_en: Low view of the dark rocky shore with the huge Moon above the ocean, the water far out from the rocks
shots.action_en: a massive tide surges in, the ocean rises quickly and floods over the dark rocks in a wide powerful wave of foam
shots.reaction_en: the water settles high over the rocks under the Moon
shots.background_en: dark rocky shore, wide ocean, huge pale Moon low in the sky

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Aquí viene lo interesante: esa Luna tiraba del océano, levantando mareas gigantes.

shots.scene_es: Cada marea funciona como un freno.
shots.start_en: The flooded dark rocks with water pouring back out toward the ocean, foam everywhere, the huge Moon in the upper part of the frame
shots.action_en: the water pulls back out to sea over the rocks, then a new wave rolls in again, slower and heavier
shots.reaction_en: the foam spreads calmly over the wet dark stone
shots.background_en: wet dark rocks, ocean, huge Moon

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Cada marea era como pisar el freno. Un poquito… y luego otro poquito.

shots.scene_es: La Tierra gira cada vez más despacio.
shots.start_en: Earth large in the foreground lit from the side, the grey Moon smaller in the distance on the right, black starry space
shots.action_en: Earth spins visibly on its axis and its rotation gradually slows down, the clouds and oceans moving more and more calmly
shots.reaction_en: Earth turns slowly and calmly in the sunlight
shots.background_en: black space, scattered stars, the distant grey Moon

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Millones de años frenando… y la Tierra empezó a girar más despacio.

shots.scene_es: La Luna se aleja poco a poco.
shots.start_en: The grey Moon in the center of the frame close to the camera, Earth glowing blue and white behind it in the distance
shots.action_en: the Moon drifts slowly away from Earth, growing smaller and moving toward the edge of the frame
shots.reaction_en: the Moon floats far from Earth in the dark
shots.background_en: black starry space, Earth in the distance

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Y la Luna, empujada por esa misma fuerza, se fue alejando de nosotros.

shots.scene_es: El giro: el día se queda atascado en 19 horas.
shots.start_en: A calm endless ocean at sunrise, the Sun half above the horizon, golden light across the water
shots.action_en: the Sun rises very slowly and the golden light spreads over the calm water while soft clouds glow orange and pink
shots.reaction_en: the Sun hangs low and still above the golden horizon
shots.background_en: calm ocean, golden sunrise, glowing clouds

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Pero aquí viene el giro: el día se quedó atascado en diecinueve horas.

shots.scene_es: El calor del Sol en la atmósfera empuja al revés.
shots.start_en: Earth seen from space with the Sun blazing at the left edge of the frame, a thin glowing blue layer of atmosphere along the lit edge of the planet
shots.action_en: warm sunlight pours over the atmosphere, a soft golden glow ripples along the thin blue layer and the clouds below swirl gently
shots.reaction_en: the atmosphere glows softly in the sunlight
shots.background_en: black space, the blazing Sun at the left edge, the thin blue atmosphere

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Casi mil millones de años así. El calor del Sol empujaba al revés.

shots.scene_es: El empate se rompe y los días siguen creciendo.
shots.start_en: The calm ocean under thick grey clouds with a narrow gap of golden light on the horizon
shots.action_en: the clouds slowly part and wide beams of sunlight break through, spreading across the ocean surface
shots.reaction_en: bright sunlight shines over the calm ocean
shots.background_en: calm ocean, parting grey clouds, golden light

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Freno contra empuje. Empate… hasta que se rompió, y los días siguieron creciendo.

shots.scene_es: Los corales antiguos registran 400 días por año.
shots.start_en: Close view of a dome-shaped ancient coral in clear turquoise water, its surface covered in fine growth bands, sun rays from above
shots.action_en: the view moves slowly closer to the fine growth bands on the coral while small fish swim past and sun rays shimmer
shots.reaction_en: the coral bands glow softly in the shimmering light
shots.background_en: turquoise water, branching corals, sun rays from above

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Según los corales, hace cuatrocientos millones de años, el año tenía cuatrocientos días.

shots.scene_es: En la época de los dinosaurios el día duraba media hora menos.
shots.start_en: A lush river plain at sunset, ferns in the foreground, a herd of long-necked dinosaurs walking calmly along the river in the middle distance
shots.action_en: the dinosaurs walk slowly along the river, the low Sun lights the ferns and the tall conifers in warm orange
shots.reaction_en: the herd keeps walking calmly in the sunset light
shots.background_en: river plain, ferns, tall conifers, sunset sky

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Y con los dinosaurios, cada día duraba media hora menos que el tuyo.

shots.scene_es: Hoy medimos con láser cómo se aleja la Luna.
shots.start_en: An observatory dome open at night with a large telescope pointing up at the bright full Moon
shots.action_en: a thin bright green laser beam shoots from the telescope up into the night sky toward the Moon and pulses steadily
shots.reaction_en: the green beam glows steadily toward the bright Moon
shots.background_en: open observatory dome, starry sky, bright full Moon

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: La Luna sigue alejándose: casi cuatro centímetros al año. Lo medimos con láser.

shots.scene_es: Cierre: una persona mira la Luna; pregunta al espectador.
shots.start_en: A person seen from behind as a dark silhouette sitting on a grassy hill at night, looking up at a bright full Moon in a sky full of stars
shots.action_en: the grass sways gently in the breeze and the stars twinkle while the person keeps looking up at the Moon
shots.reaction_en: the silhouette sits still under the bright Moon
shots.background_en: grassy hill, bright full Moon, starry sky, distant city lights

dialogue.speaker: Narrador
dialogue.line: Esta noche, cuando la mires, piénsalo: ¿qué harías con un día de seis horas?
